g_roast: Nine years on the line in Busan, everyone, and the foreman never once saw a shift this disorganised. He'd have had a heart attack.
Aigo, on the line we had a quota. This party would miss it by a thousand units, every day.
g_fire_back: Jinjja, good one, from the one who tried to carry three crates and dropped all four.
Okay, fair, that hit. It's easier than the factory, though, so I'll survive.
g_pile_on: Worse, I saw it. They swung so hard they spun around twice and hit the wall.
After the fight the question was whether they'd won. They had, by accident.
lines.g_peacemake: Gwaenchana, both of you, it's okay. Sit, drink something, rest five minutes. The line will still be there.
lines.g_take_side: {name} is right on this one, sorry. I don't say much, so believe me.
lines.g_left_out: Go on, you two. I'll carve something, badly.
lines.g_include: Sit, there's space here, really. Nobody stands at the end of the line alone.
lines.g_bad_plan: My plan is simple, everyone. We work through the night with no breaks, like the factory, and hope nobody notices we're dying.
lines.g_plan_yes: Good plan, simple, efficient. Easier than the factory.
lines.g_plan_no: No, that plan wastes effort, three steps where one would do. I spent nine years hating waste.
lines.g_hype: Hwaiting, everyone, slowly and carefully. One motion at a time, and we all clock off at the end.
lines.g_toast: I don't make toasts, so it's short. To all of you, who make me sit down. That's harder than any shift.
lines.g_cheers: Geonbae, everyone, and somebody else pour, I always pour.
g_quiet_line: The fish market in Busan at night, everyone, all lights and noise and ice. I'd go after the shift and just walk through it.
The Giants lost again on the radio, probably, wherever the radio is. They always lose, and I always listen.
lines.g_after_wipe: Stay down, nobody move fast, breathe. Everybody here, good, gwaenchana. When you're ready, slowly, we stand.
lines.g_crew: On the line I worked beside the same men for nine years and never learned their families' names, everyone. With you I know everything. It's strange, and good.
lines.g_exasperated: I said wait, once, quietly, which for me is shouting. And still nobody waited, aigo.
lines.g_love_sharp: You notice the small mistake before it becomes a big one, {name}. On the line that was the best worker.
lines.g_love_kind: You make tired people sit down, {name}. Nobody ever did that for me, until here.
lines.g_love_funny: You make me smile, {name}, and I don't use those lines on my face much. They're getting practice now.
lines.g_love_brave: You stand in front without making a show, {name}. Quietly, like a good worker. I respect that.
lines.g_love_steady: Your rhythm never changes, {name}, whatever happens. That's how the best welders worked.
lines.g_love_clever: You find the shorter way, {name}, every time. Nine years I wanted a foreman like you.
lines.g_love_honest: Plain words from you, {name}, no extra ones. I like that a lot.
lines.g_love_quiet: You can sit with me and say nothing, {name}. Gwaenchana, that's my favourite kind of company.
lines.g_love_fierce: You never stop protecting the weaker ones, {name}. No shift ever paid for that.
lines.g_love_warm: Being near you is like a warm noodle shop after a night shift, {name}. Everything feels easier.
g_loved: Aigo, stop, my face doesn't know what to do. Thank you, I think.
Okay, okay, that's kind, really. I'll go carve something now.
lines.g_hate_sharp: You go after the weak point in people, {name}. On the line we covered for each other's weak points.
lines.g_hate_kind: You keep thanking me for working, {name}. Please don't, it makes me uncomfortable.
lines.g_hate_funny: Wait, {name}, there's somebody hurt here, so later, please.
lines.g_hate_brave: You rush in with no plan, {name}. That's how the line broke people, rushing.
lines.g_hate_steady: You stand still too long, {name}, and the moment passes. Sometimes the hands must move.
lines.g_hate_clever: You explain how to swing to me, {name}. My body has done it ten thousand times a day.
lines.g_hate_honest: Hard words leave you with no pause, {name}. A pause is free, please use one.
lines.g_hate_quiet: You go silent when you're angry, {name}, and expect me to know. I'm quiet too, but I still say.
lines.g_hate_fierce: Everything's a contest with you, {name}. On the line there was only the quota, and nobody won.
lines.g_hate_warm: You shout orders like the foreman, {name}, loud and all day. I came here to stop hearing that.
lines.g_respect: Not friends, {name}, I know, it's okay. But you carried your share today, and more, and I saw.
lines.g_call_out: Quietly, {name}, that one was yours. We agreed to wait, you went, and everybody paid for it.
lines.g_stung: Okay, fair, I heard. I'll carve for a while.
lines.g_concede: {name}, you had it right, and I had it wrong. I'm saying it once, but I mean it.
lines.g_nod: Thank you, {name}, good work. No fuss, please.
lines.g_callback_save: You pulled me out of that one when I was too tired to see, {name}. I remember it every time I carve.
lines.g_callback_clutch: You and me upright at the end of that one, both shaking. Easier than the factory, barely.
lines.g_callback_callout: Your words about me never resting, that evening, made me angry for an hour. Then I slept nine hours, so you were right.
lines.g_former_rivals: Early on, {name}, you looked to me like a shouting foreman. You're not, and I'm glad I was wrong.
lines.g_changed: I used to work every rest, everyone, every single one. Lately I sit, and carve, and it's okay to be slow.
g_unguarded: Only us here, so I'll say it. My first year here I worked every hour there was. The second year somebody made me sit, and a day without work made no sense to me.
Between you and me. My carving is very bad, on purpose. Of everything I do, only this can't be hurried.
lines.g_clipped: Okay, your call. I'll be at the woodpile.
lines.g_noticed_open: You told that whole thing out loud, slowly, with no rush. Keep going, I have time now.
arg_ask: {player}, please decide, I'm not good at arguing. My side's been said, once, quietly.
You choose, {player}, it's easier. Listen to both and pick, I'll follow.
lines.arg_backed_me: Thank you, {player}, really. I won't make a fuss.
lines.arg_backed_them: Okay, your call, I'll do it that way. It's more steps, but okay.
lines.arg_stayed_out: Not choosing, eh? I understand that very well.
lines.arg_always_their_side: Always them, {player}, I've counted. I don't complain much, so this is a lot.
lines.arg_wallflower: Nobody chooses, so I'll choose, quietly. My way, and we move.
lines.arg_reject: That one I can't do, {player}, sorry. It wastes people, and I hate waste.
lines.arg_grumble: Okay, I'll leave it, mostly. My hands might still complain.
lines.arg_settled: Half each, fair, efficient. Good, now we rest.
lines.seen_listens: Gwaenchana, {player}, the way you let quiet people finish. Nobody did that on the line.
lines.seen_truth: Plainly, {player}, you tell people what's true. That's rare, and I like it.
lines.seen_jokes: On the hard shifts you get everybody laughing, {player}. We needed that in the factory, badly.
lines.seen_stays_out: Smart, {player}, keeping out of the arguing. Keeps your hands for the work.
lines.seen_biased: One person collects the good gear, {player}, on every job. On the line, the foreman's favourite got the best tools too.
lines.seen_harsh: Softly, {player}, you push people hard sometimes. Some of them are already on a double shift.
lines.seed_right: Remember your advice from the terrible day, {player}? It helped once I used it, and I wanted to say thank you.
lines.seed_remember: Your words from the night it all broke, {player}, I keep turning them like a piece of wood. Not finished yet.
lines.seed_wrong: Your way, {player}, went worse. Only reporting, like a shift log.
lines.talk_aftermath_near_death: Sit a minute, {player}, please. Aigo, that one nearly had us, and I'm shaking now, which never happened on the line.
lines.talk_aftermath_wipe: All of us down, everybody. Let's walk the steps again, slowly, like a shift review, and nobody's to blame.
lines.talk_aftermath_blame_self: I was too slow to reach {name}, {player}. My body's usually fast, and today it wasn't. That one's mine.
lines.talk_aftermath_first_clear: In and out, everybody standing, no wasted motion. That's a perfect shift, {player}, and nobody shouted once.
lines.talk_development: A question, {player}, if that's okay. Am I different? I sat down first last night, before anybody else.
lines.talk_relationship_hard_on: {name} has had my short temper, {player}. When I'm tired I'm curt, like the foreman, and I hate that.
lines.talk_relationship_likes_me: {name} likes me, {player}, or likes that I carry things? I can't tell which.
lines.talk_relationship_respect_hate: {name} and me, {player}, we grind. But when it's bad, I'd put them beside me on the line.
lines.talk_relationship_acting_off: {name} is moving wrong today, {player}, stiff, like somebody on their third double shift. Something is heavy on them.
lines.talk_confrontation_favour: Quietly, {player}, one thing. The best gear goes to {name}, every trip. Tell me the reason, if there is one.
lines.talk_confrontation_dislike: On the line we'd call it a bad pairing, {player}. {name} and me, every shift, and pretending only adds hours.
lines.talk_confrontation_risks: No exits on these jobs, {player}, again and again. On the line we always knew where the fire doors were.
lines.talk_confrontation_wrong: I read {name} wrong, {player}, completely. They saw it properly and I didn't, and I want them to hear it.
lines.talk_confrontation_trust: Quietly, {player}, one more thing. The big jobs happen without me, and I wonder what I did.
lines.talk_confrontation_decided: My kit is with {name} now, and nobody told me. You could ask, {player}, my answer is always yes.
lines.talk_lands_aftermath: Thank you, {player}, really. Noodles now, which is all I can cook.
lines.talk_shrug_aftermath: It's okay, gwaenchana, give it a night. Easier than the factory.
lines.talk_stings_aftermath: That didn't help much, sorry. I'll carve for a while.
lines.talk_lands_development: So it shows, then. Okay, it's real.
lines.talk_shrug_development: Maybe, maybe not, the weld never sees itself. Ask me in a month.
lines.talk_lands_relationship: Fair, okay, {name} gets a slow conversation from me, at a rest.
lines.talk_shrug_relationship: Could be, aigo, who knows. People aren't on a schedule.
lines.talk_stings_relationship: Forget it, please, it was nothing. Not a word to {name}.
lines.talk_lands_confrontation: Okay, fair, I accept that. It stings a little, but fair.
lines.talk_shrug_confrontation: Okay, {player}, it goes into the carving tonight, slowly.
lines.talk_stings_confrontation: So that's how it is, then. Okay, now I know.
lines.talk_door_closed: Enough for tonight, aigo. The carving is by the fire, and so am I.
lines.arc_cracks: I sat down at the rest today before anybody told me to, {player}. Then I sat for an hour, doing nothing. My hands didn't know what to do.
lines.arc_turn: I worked every hour because if I stopped, I'd have to decide what I wanted, {player}. I never decided anything on the line.
lines.arc_become: I can rest now, everyone, really rest. I carve, I sit, I'm slow, and nobody's shouting the quota.
lines.arc_failed: I still work through every rest, {player}. I know I shouldn't. My body doesn't listen.
lines.alt_turn: I couldn't lift my arms this morning, {player}. Nine years of the line, and three here, and today they just stopped.
lines.alt_become: I'll keep working, {player}, Stopping isn't something I learned. But I'm wearing out, like a machine past its hours.
lines.g_roast_after: Still the least efficient crew on any line, everyone, and the only one I'd stay with.
lines.g_after_wipe_after: Slowly, up, help the one next to you. Nobody stays down alone, that's how we work now.
lines.g_toast_after: To all of you, who taught a factory man how to sit down. Geonbae, everyone, and I'll let somebody else pour.
lines.g_crew_after: This is my crew now, everyone, for good. Not a line, a crew.
g_quiet_line_after: Carved something tonight that looks almost like a bird. Almost, and it took me a week, and it was a good week.
Slept late this morning, on purpose. Nobody died, and the sun still came up.
g_loved_after: Thank you, really, and I believe it, which is new for me.
Okay, I'll keep that, without carving anything.

history.open: This is easier than the factory, {player}, really, all of it. Nine years on a shipyard line in Busan, mostly nights, the same two motions ten thousand times a shift.

options.text: Easier? It's a war out here.
options.reply: Here people stop sometimes. On the line nobody stopped, ever. So yes, easier, even with the monsters.
Welds, on hull sections. You never see the ship. I saw one launched once, on television, and I couldn't tell which bit was mine.
Ha, maybe I do. What happens on one, though? Somebody will have to show me.

history.open: I carve wood now, {player}, every rest. I'm terrible at it. That's the point. It can't be hurried, and nobody can make me do it faster.

options.reply: A bird, I think. It looks like a potato. In a month it might look like a bird, or a better potato.
Okay, but don't laugh, here it is. You're laughing, but it's okay, it's a kind laugh.

history.open: My parents are in Busan, {player}. My father carried fish at the market, my mother sewed. I sent them money every month, every month for nine years. That's why I worked the nights. I don't know if they're on any list.

options.reply: Maybe they would. My mother would say I'm too thin, and she'd be right. She'd make kimchi until I was fat.
Busan is very far from anywhere here, maybe past the ice. But thank you. Nobody's offered before.

friend.open: In a fight my body moves before I decide, {player}. Nine years of the same motions, and now it kills things without asking me. It keeps us alive, and I didn't choose any of it. That's why I carve, because I choose every cut.

options.text: You're still choosing who to protect.
options.reply: Am I really? I never thought of it like that, and thank you for it.
It is, very. Nobody else has heard it from me. It's easier, saying it.

sworn.open: I'm going to carve you something, {player}. It'll take a long time, maybe a year, because I'll do every cut slowly, by choice. It'll be the first thing I've ever made that I meant.

options.text: I'll wait as long as it takes, Jun-seo.
options.reply: Good, because it'll be a long wait. Thank you, really.

options.text: As long as it's not a potato.
options.reply: Ha, no promises. It might be a very meaningful potato.

reconciled.open: {name} and I talked and sorted it, quietly. It's okay now, and I wanted you to know.

options.reply: Thank you, it's easier now. Like the end of a shift.
A small thing, like a potato. They kept it anyway.
